title: Count the Words
prompt: A writing widget shows a live word count. Write a function that returns how many words are in the sentence. Words are separated by one or more spaces, leading and trailing spaces should be ignored, and an empty or all-space string has 0 words.

explanation.beginner:
Example: countWords("the quick brown fox") produces 4. The result must follow this precise rule: A writing widget shows a live word count. Write a function that returns how many words are in the sentence. Words are separated by one or more spaces, leading and trailing spaces should be ignored, and an empty or all-space string has 0 words. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “ignores extra spaces”: input ["  hello   world "] produces 2. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
